text:
jamie: @here ClearBridge reporting intermittent 503s and p99 spikes on their dedicated pool. CS flagged this as P1. Need an owner and a short-term mitigation timeline. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CB-4321

noah: seeing ~6% 503s last 10m, they're failing at checkout. Customer asked for a temporary workaround by EOD their timezone.

maria: digging into logs — routing proxy handoff occasionally returns 502/503 during autoscale events. Looks like a brief race when a new worker registers. Suggest pinning traffic to the legacy routing path for the customer while we stabilize.

kai: I can do the pin + canary. Which route id should I target?

jamie: cb-prod-route. Proposal: pin to model-variant "rtx-small-2" (quantized) for lower tail latency. This is an acceptable quality trade for short term per CS. Plan: canary 10% -> 30m monitor -> ramp if green. Owners: pin -> @kai, monitoring -> @maria, customer comm -> @noah.

maria: quantized variant compatibility confirmed. small quality regression expected; CS agreed. I'll set alerts and watch the p95/p99 and error rate.

kai: scheduling canary now. running override command: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes/cb-prod-route/override \n -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \n -d '{"variant":"rtx-small-2","traffic_pct":10}'
```

deploy-bot: pipeline job started: cb-override-1768890000 (canary override).

maria: added quick Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/route-metrics/cb-prod-route — watching p95, p99, and 5m error rate. Alert threshold set: error_rate_5m > 3% -> page.

noah: told the customer we have a mitigation in ~30–45m and asked them not to run large loads until we confirm. They're acknowledging.

jamie: also opened bug CB-4322 to track root cause (routing handshake race). Linking the root-cause bug to the customer ticket.

maria: noticed GPU-7 in cb-pool showing memory pressure around the same timestamps. I triggered a temporary autoscale add +1 to the pool to relieve pressure: `scale pool cb-pool +1` (manual). This should reduce hot-worker churn while we watch.

kai: canary deployed at 11:04 PST. Quick metrics: p50 42ms, p95 180ms, p99 430ms (previous p99 ~980ms), error rate down to 1.2% at 10% traffic.

noah: customer reports decreased failures on their side. They're asking ETA for full ramp/fix.

jamie: target: if canary is stable for 30m, ramp to 100% over the next hour (so full ramp target ~12:30 PST). If we see any quality regression or increase in errors, rollback plan is: undo override -> route to hosted fallback.

maria: monitoring alert will escalate if error_rate_5m > 3% during ramp. I'll own the 1hr stability window checks.

kai: noted. I'll post back at the 30m mark with both metrics and logs.

deploy-bot: cb-override-1768890000 canary succeeded (10% traffic applied). No deploy errors.

jamie: thanks all — please ping here with any blocker. Adding leadership FYI: @cto. :thumbsup:

maria: small follow-up — I scheduled a postmortem playbook run for the CB-4322 bug, will coordinate with runtime to validate the registration handshake sequence tomorrow.

noah: I'll update the customer with the ramp plan and expected SLA impact window.

kai: end-of-canary update in 20m.

jamie: excellent. Closing the loop when ramp completes or if we hit >3% errors. Appreciated. :raised_hands:
